description: Pay-per-call data over x402: air quality, border waits, fuel prices, market research.
name: io.github.DV1-321/scalpstream-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base-mainnet private key holding a little USDC, used to pay per call. Leave unset to run in preview-only mode, where every paid tool returns the free preview and the exact price instead. Gas is sponsored by the facilitator, so the wallet needs USDC and no ETH. Use a throwaway key.
environmentVariables.name: EVM_BASE_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single call quoted above this many dollars. Defaults to 0.10. Checked before anything is signed, so a refusal costs nothing.
environmentVariables.name: SCALPMCP_MAX_PRICE_USD

environmentVariables.description: Refuse once this process has spent this many dollars in total. Defaults to 2.00.
environmentVariables.name: SCALPMCP_BUDGET_USD

title: ScalpStream
